scenarios.reasoning: Strong diagnostic reasoning and honest about limits, but it stopped short on the one step the prompt stressed most (reading App.config's contents), which weakens both the root-cause proof and the precision of the recommended fix.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 for System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource in DeviceConfigClient, net8.0 TFM
Discovered per-TFM assembly version differences (10.0.0.0 net8.0 vs 10.0.0.3 net472)
Found App.config binding redirect with newVersion=10.0.0.3
Traced AppConfigFile property into RAR for all TFMs
Explained RAR unification to 10.0.0.3 conflicting with actual 10.0.0.0
Noted the error message is misleading (redirect applied before reporting)
Proposed removing the hardcoded binding redirect, noting AutoGenerateBindingRedirects handles net472
